headline: Melton's eight threes carry the Warriors past the Kings
dek: De’Anthony Melton made 8 threes, and the Warriors’ bench scored 61.
three: De’Anthony Melton: 24 points, all on threes
His 8 threes, on 12 tries, tied his career high. He had 7 assists too.
Warriors up 25 after the first, then held off the Kings’ 25–10 run in the third
Won it off the bench and from three
Bench points 61–19; threes made 20–14. The bench’s 61 points were a season best.
top: off the bench, back from injury
